label: Pritchard's quasi-fideism, from Über Gewißheit: all belief depends for its rational assessment on…
paraphrase: Pritchard's quasi-fideism (as reported), from Über Gewißheit: all belief depends for its rational assessment on hinge commitments that are not themselves rationally grounded and are not beliefs; religious belief is no different in kind, so a life of faith can include rational religious beliefs.
